title: Daughter of Chabahar
description:
Acrylic on canvas

Inspired by a photograph I took during my visit to Chabahar, southern Iran. The traditional clothing, vibrant colours, and quiet beauty of everyday life inspired this painting.

title: Children of Chabahar No. 2
description:
Acrylic on canvas

Inspired by my own photography, capturing a quiet moment of childhood, where the sea meets the horizon and dreams beyond what the eye can see.

title: After Mahmoud Farshchian
description:
Watercolour on paper

A hand-painted reproduction of an original work by Mahmoud Farshchian.

title: Feline Portrait
description:
Coloured pencil on paper

A portrait of a friend's cat, capturing its distinctive features and gentle character.

title: Decorative Portrait
description: A hand-painted reproduction featuring geometric patterns, vibrant colours, and gold-toned details.

title: Sama — The Whirling Dance
description:
Watercolour painting

Inspired by Sama, the traditional Sufi whirling dance, this painting explores movement, spirituality, and cultural expression.

Created in response to an exhibition theme and exhibited at the Shenkman Arts Centre in Ottawa, Canada.
